title: PackedPoints as a buffer object indexed by point, with the shared triangle, frame and angle maths on it and MeshTopology
user-messages:
> This is a bigger change than ENG-43’s vector swap: it touches signatures across about 70 files. Do you want it in ENG-43, or in its own worktree with ENG-43 landing first?

also yes lets make this a new ticket
description:
Packed n-point buffers are bare float[] (positions, per-region points, Coons extra positions), so the type does not say "many xyz points", every reader writes index arithmetic, and four helpers do the same job. ENG-43 added a static PackedPoints (at(float[], offset) / store(float[], offset, Vector3f)) taking an array offset (3*i). Turn it into an object that owns the buffer and is indexed by point.

Sketch (ixdar.geometry.mesh.data.representation.PackedPoints):
- Vector3f at(int point) returns a new vector; set(int point, Vector3f); add(int point, Vector3f); int append(Vector3f) grows the buffer and returns the index; int size(); float[] array() exposes the backing array for GPU upload and hot kernels.

Sites (counts from the ENG-43 worktree):
- About 145 raw p[3*i+k] reads/writes in 47 files: sculpt (StrokeSketch, KeyCandidates, SculptSync, SculptStroke, FillStroke, OffsetCrests, StrokeChain, StrokeRefinement, SilhouetteStroke, DisplacementSum, KeyStrokeMatch), segmentation (MeshSegmenter, MorseSmaleDecomposer, SemanticPatchDecomposer, PatchBoundaryWalker, MscCellAssembly, DiscreteGradient), ops (MeshSmoothing, MeshMergeByDistance, MeshFolds, MeshProjection), node graph modifiers (ExtrudeMeshNode, InsetFacesNode, SubdivisionMeshNode, InstanceOnPointsNode, CurveToMeshNode, BiRailLoftNode, BirailLoftMeshNode), procgen (RoomPlacer, RoomPlacer3D), LineSet, HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.
- The 156 static PackedPoints.at/store calls (70 files) move to the instance API.
- Duplicate writers HalfEdgeMesh.setVector (public), HalfEdgeMeshOps.setVector/addVector and ArrangementDiagnostic.write become set/add.
- ArrayList<Float> position builders (extraPos and friends in CoonsExtrudeMeshNode, CoonsInsetFacesNode, CoonsLoopCutNode, InsetFacesNode and 7 more files) become append, with no boxing and no final copy.
- Fields documented as "xyz packed" (RingRegions.ringJoinPoint, regionCreasePoint, regionLabelPoint, positions buffers) take the type.

Leave alone: tight kernels that index array() directly (smoothing, chamfer-style loops, sculpt solvers) where the index form is clearer; per-vertex scalar arrays (GoalProjection.offset, MeshProjection.offset); double[] packed buffers unless they fall out naturally; HalfEdgeMesh's internal position storage stays behind vertexPosition.

Rules as in ENG-43: no out-parameters on our own methods, last-ulp differences accepted, the current suite must pass.

Widened: consolidate the private geometry copies onto PackedPoints and MeshTopology. No new helper classes (no Triangles, no Frames).
- PackedPoints, triangle maths over three point indices: Vector3f normal(int a, int b, int c), double area(int a, int b, int c), double cornerAngle(int at, int b, int c). Replaces MeshRepair.unitNormal, TriangleGeometry.area, MeshHoleFiller.triangleArea, PatchDecomposerCLI.triAngle, SemanticPatchDecomposer.triangleAngle, and PatchRectangleMap's twice-area.
- MeshTopology: faceArea, faceNormal and faceCentroid implemented through those PackedPoints methods so the maths lives once; add a returning faceNormal(int) and cornerAngle(halfEdge) (replaces HalfEdgeMesh:1440's copy, AttachToSurfaceNode.faceNormal and QuadLayoutOverlay.faceNormal).
- Frames: Matrix3f MeshTopology.tangentFrame(int vertexId) from the vertex normal, and a static MeshTopology.tangentFrame(Vector3f normal) it calls, for frames built from an arbitrary axis (TriangleBvh.hemisphereBasis, which returns a float[9] today, GirdlingPlane, PrincipalDirectionField, CrossField's out-parameter tangent and the other ~14 files that each pick their own helper axis).
- JOML calls, no helper: angle between two vectors becomes Vector3f.angle (clamped; fixes the unclamped acos(dot) NaN risk in SemanticPatchDecomposer x3, PatchBoundaryWalker, PatchDecomposerCLI, HalfEdgeMesh:1440, and replaces the clamped copies in MeshHoleFiller, IntrinsicTriangulation, SurfaceMetric, SurfaceSpline, SurfaceSplineTracer, MeshSkeletonComparator); removing a normal component (v - n dot(n, v), 15 lines in 7 files) becomes v.fma(-v.dot(n), n).
Out of scope: 2D (Vector2f / float[2] / ax-ay pairs), barycentric weights (stay double[]), lerp and centroid one-offs. Intrinsic-metric angles computed from edge lengths (law of cosines) stay scalar.
definition-of-done:
1. PackedPoints is an instance class indexed by point (at, set, add, append, size, array); the static offset-based at/store are gone.
2. The listed raw p[3*i+k] sites outside tight kernels use it; any left are listed on the ticket with the reason.
3. HalfEdgeMesh.setVector, HalfEdgeMeshOps.setVector/addVector and ArrangementDiagnostic.write are replaced.
4. No ArrayList<Float> position builder remains.
5. The full build (checkstyle included) and the unit tests pass.
6. A launch entry and screenshot show a mesh-building node graph (extrude or inset) rendering as before.

7. PackedPoints has normal, area and cornerAngle over point indices; the private copies listed in the description are gone and their callers use these or the MeshTopology methods.
8. MeshTopology has a returning faceNormal(int), cornerAngle(halfEdge) and tangentFrame (instance from a vertex, static from a normal, both returning Matrix3f); faceArea/faceNormal/faceCentroid share the PackedPoints maths; TriangleBvh.hemisphereBasis no longer returns float[9].
9. No unclamped acos(dot) remains for the angle between two vectors; those sites use Vector3f.angle (or Vector3d.angle); normal-component removal uses fma.
testing-plan:
1. Full mvn -o verify passes.
2. Node graph modifier, Coons, sculpt, segmentation and ring-region tests pass.
3. Run a scene with an extrude/inset node graph and the ring scene; screenshots under tmp/ match before.

4. Curvature, cross-field, BVH ray, hole-filler, mesh-repair and geodesic tests pass (last-ulp differences accepted).
unknowns: Should HalfEdgeMesh store its positions in a PackedPoints, or keep float[] behind vertexPosition?
Is a double-precision variant needed, or do the few double[] packed buffers stay as they are?
changes-made: MeshTopology: faceNormal(int) (moved from HalfEdgeMesh), facePoints(face) as a PackedPoints, cornerAngle(halfEdge), tangentFrame(vertexId) and static tangentFrame(normal) returning Matrix3f (Gram-Schmidt of x, or y when |n.x| >= 0.9); faceArea/faceCentroid use facePoints. Removed: HalfEdgeMesh.interiorAngleAtVertex, AttachToSurfaceNode.faceNormal, QuadLayoutOverlay.faceNormal, TriangleBvh.hemisphereBasis, CrossField.arbitraryTangent (+BASIS_AXIS_PICK_THRESHOLD), CurveToMeshNode.stablePerp, CurveSweepMeshNode.fillStablePerpendicularTo, SemanticPatchDecomposer.unitDir; frames in GirdlingPlane, PrincipalDirectionField, NDirectionField, CurvatureConstraints, BiRailLoftNode, StrokeKeyRoute, KeyCandidates, OffsetCrests, StrokeElementGrid now use tangentFrame.

Angles: Vector3f/Vector3d/Vector2d.angle in SemanticPatchDecomposer (dihedrals, corner count), PatchBoundaryWalker, MeshHoleFiller.angleAt, SurfaceSplineTracer, SurfaceSpline, MeshSkeletonComparator, InjectivityConstraints (was unclamped 2D acos). Normal removal is fma in HalfEdgeMesh.projectDirectionToFaceAngle, NDirectionField, PrincipalDirectionField, AssignBezierHandlesNode. SemanticPatchDecomposer's two k-means copies share one Lloyd loop; RoomPlacer reuses RoomPlacer3D.collidesAny.

Behaviour notes: IcosphereMeshNode midpoints divide per component (JOML div multiplies by a reciprocal) so nested icospheres keep exactly shared points; CoincidentAnchorSaveTest and SliverCollapseToolTest caught this. TriangleBvh hemisphere rays keep their old orientation; only the helper-axis switch moved from |x|>=0.6 to >=0.9. PrincipalDirectionField skips a vertex with a zero normal instead of using an x fallback.

Second pass after review: converted the sculpt sites (KeyCandidates, FillStroke, SculptStroke incl. elementFraction now taking point indices, ChainStroke, SilhouetteStroke, KeyStrokeMatch, StrokeRefinement, SculptSync, OffsetCrests), PatchBoundaryWalker (unitDir and EPSILON removed; straightest step ranked by angle), MeshMergeByDistance writes, NearestVertex entry copy, cell lookup and samePosition; MeshHoleFiller.triangleArea and PatchRectangleMap's twice-area now use PackedPoints.area. generate_board.py gained update --remove-change N.

Third pass: x,y,z-taking APIs now take Vector3fc (NearestVertex.within/nearest, FaceAnchors.anchor, StrokeElementGrid.cellOf). Methods that returned packed float[] now return PackedPoints: MeshTopology.packedPositions, MeshDistance normalizedPositions/normalized/inFrame/centred, MeshSmoothing.umbrella, SemanticPatchDecomposer positionsById/triangleNormals/vertexNormals (and EdgeDihedrals' faceNormals and positions), CoonsEvaluator sampleGrid/blendGrid (nearestDistanceSquared takes PackedPoints and a Vector3fc; one shared coonsPoint), BezierFit.fitCubic, CoonsReconstructionError.compute and PatchBoundaryWalker.extract take PackedPoints, CurveGeometry curvePositions/drawnPositions, RingTool.positionsOf, CapsuleAabbTest.closestPair (P then Q). MeshCanonicalFingerprint corners are Vector3f (same bytes hashed). Single-caller helpers this exposed were inlined (PatchBoundaryWalker walkRing/pickNext, BoundarySnap.edgeCost, MscCellAssembly.nearestMaxByPosition, PatchSurfaceGeometry.coonsBlend, RingTool closedPolylineSegments/markedEdgeSegments, fingerprint corner/sortCorners/encodeTriangles); LoopCutNode appends its cut vertices to the positions buffer; InstanceOnPointsNode.positionsFromBundle inlined.

Left as is, with reason: SurfaceMetric.cornerAngle and IntrinsicTriangulation.cornerAngle (law of cosines from edge lengths, kept scalar per the ticket); double[] buffers PackedPoints (float) cannot hold: LineSet, AnchoredStroke.curve, RingTool.loopPositionsOf, SeamlessParameterization, KeyCandidates landingXyz, SculptSync onBase; SoA inputs: MeshHoleFiller vertexX/Y/Z and MeshMergeByDistance cluster sums; kernels indexing array(): NearestVertex inner loops, MeshSmoothing, MeshFolds, TriangleBvh, the SubdivisionMeshNode Catmull-Clark kernel; DisplacementSum.offsetXyz (dense per-vertex offsets). ArrayMesh.positions stays float[] (the triangle-soup store). Triangle soups and overlay groups stay float[]: MeshRepair cornersOf, SeamlessDiagnosis.offendingVertexPositions, Draft.points. The only views left are over interleaved GPU/file buffers (GltfMeshParser, AssimpModelImporter, HalfEdgeMeshRuntime, RingTool ring lines); the only wrap is MeshLoader.indexedMesh at the IO boundary. SemanticPatchDecomposer's private float[] helpers and ExtrudeMeshNode's single-caller methods stay, as before.

Fifth pass: SurfaceRidges.lines is List<PackedPoints> (SurfaceRidgesRoute and StrokeKeyRoute no longer wrap each line). ReferenceStrokes keeps one PackedPoints landed plus landedRadius, the first coveredPoints from finished pictures, so finishing a picture is a count update rather than a copy (COVERED_FIELDS removed). StrokePursuit's moves are moveVertices (int[]) and moveOffsets (PackedPoints) instead of float quadruples carrying the vertex index as a float: lift returns the touched vertices, takeOffsets reads the offsets out of the thread's sum, atom and foldLimits take both. StrokeSketch.cellCamera reads its centre into a Vector3f instead of a one-point view.

Sixth pass: PackedPoints.wrap deleted. MeshLoader.indexedMesh takes PackedPoints positions (the mesh keeps them; the ArrayMesh fallback gets toArray()); the OBJ and OFF parsers append to a PackedPoints instead of a boxed List<Float>, PLY sets one, and glTF's weldedPositions is one. Still float[]: the parsers' normals and DisplacementSum.offsetXyz (dense per-vertex offsets), both candidates to convert.

Left as is, with reason: SurfaceMetric.cornerAngle and IntrinsicTriangulation.cornerAngle (law of cosines from edge lengths, kept scalar per the ticket); double[] xyz buffers PackedPoints (float) cannot hold, pending a decision on a double variant: TracedSurfacePath, SurfaceSpline/SplineAnchorFit polylines, ImplicitFit, LineSet curves, AnchoredStroke.curve, RingTool.loopPositionsOf, SeamlessParameterization, KeyCandidates landingXyz, SculptSync onBase; SoA inputs: MeshHoleFiller vertexX/Y/Z and MeshMergeByDistance cluster sums; Vector3Field (its own float[] field type, built from .array() in FieldContextImpl, SwitchVectorNode, InputTangentNode, VectorMathNode). IO and GPU boundaries: GltfMeshParser source records (ByteBuffer fill, read through view), GltfMeshWriter's FloatBuffer put, QuadLayoutOverlay's VertexBuffer upload, the interleaved views in GltfMeshParser, AssimpModelImporter, HalfEdgeMeshRuntime and RingTool ring lines, SurfaceDots rows and LineSet vertices. TriangleBvh node and triangle boxes are box records, not points. SemanticPatchDecomposer's private helpers already take PackedPoints.

Seventh pass (five subagents): every remaining point buffer that unpacked .array() or stored packed float[] xyz is PackedPoints read by point index. Sculpt: MeshFolds (startCornerXyz, cornerXyz, normalByFaceId, constructor and update), MeshSmoothing (umbrella, unfold, ramp, ringMean without its components parameter), SmoothMeshNode, DisplacementSum.offsetXyz (combinedXyz removed; sculpted goes through MeshVertexOffset.atPositions), StrokeSculpt, StrokePursuit, StrokeSketch.anchoredXyzByShape, StrokeAnchors, MidpointSplit, QuadLayoutNode. Repair and query: TriangleGeometry ray helpers, TriangleBvh.positions and its corner soup, SurfaceFaceLocator, MeshTopologyAnalysis, MeshRepair (13 unpacks, corner soups cornersOf/cornersWhere/changedSinceOrientationCorners/treeOver; the async prune tree reads the frozen copy), ArrayMesh positions and normals, MeshLoader.indexedMesh normals and the OBJ/PLY/glTF normals. Kernels: SubdivisionMeshNode Catmull-Clark (no temporary arrays or arraycopy), CurveDeformNode, SkeletonSensitivityAnalyzer, CharrotGregoryPatchSampler (no callers; converted, not deleted). Tools: Draft.points (State JSON unchanged), SurfaceSpline.anchorXyz renamed anchorPositions, RegionExplosion.regionCentroids, SeamlessDiagnosis. Overlay chain: MeshOverlayRuntime setDiagnostic/setPatchClouds, SurfaceDots.addCloud, SurfaceFaceLocator.appendSegments, HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.cloudRadius, ModelScene.focusOrbitOn, EmbeddedTMeshScene, ArrangementDiagnostic, QuadLayoutOverlay, ConnectionTool, RingTool graphRingSegments/perRing and ClosedRingTool hover take List<PackedPoints>; segment s has endpoints 2s and 2s+1. RingTool.SEGMENT_FLOATS now has no users (left for the user to decide).

Eighth pass (five subagents): TriangleBvh nodeMin/nodeMax are PackedPoints (one point per node) and triangleBounds/nodeBoxes/columnBounds are two-point-per-box PackedPoints (BOX_CORNERS replaces BOX_FLOATS); MeshMergeByDistance reads mesh.packedPositions and sums clusters in one PackedPoints; MeshHoleFiller stores loop/ring/vertex positions as PackedPoints and copies one axis into double for each fairing solve (PackedPoints.set(point, axis, value) added); Vector3Field is record Vector3Field(PackedPoints points), DungeonGrids.pointBundle takes PackedPoints; the surface-path double[] xyz buffers (TracedSurfacePath, IntrinsicPathTracer, SurfaceGeodesics, PlaneSurfaceLoop, SurfaceMetric, SurfacePathCrossings, SurfaceSpline, SplineAnchorFit, SurfaceSplineTracer, GeodesicRefit, AuthoredSplineRing) and the curvature ones (ImplicitFit, SurfaceRidges, KeyCandidates, OffsetCrests) are float PackedPoints with arithmetic kept in double locals. QuadRingToolTest's on-line check uses FLOAT_STORED_POINT_TOLERANCE = 1e-6 (point 2 was 2.04e-8 off after float storage; path length still 1e-9); SurfaceRidgesTest's finite difference divides by the float step actually taken. Now unused, awaiting the user: BOX_FLOATS gone; COORDINATES_PER_POINT in GeodesicRefit, SurfaceGeodesics, PlaneSurfaceLoop, SurfaceSplineTracer; RingRegionExtraction.XYZ; FlipGeodesicsScanBenchmark.POSITION_STRIDE. Verify: 813 tests, 0 failures.

Deleted the unused COORDINATES_PER_POINT (GeodesicRefit, SurfaceGeodesics, PlaneSurfaceLoop, SurfaceSplineTracer), RingRegionExtraction.XYZ, FlipGeodesicsScanBenchmark.POSITION_STRIDE and RingTool.SEGMENT_FLOATS; CharrotGregoryPatchSampler kept on the user's word. Retimed against master f508c94f, 5 alternating cold rounds, medians: quad layout unchanged within noise (SeamlessPipeline cross field 0.298->0.323 s, seamless 0.696->0.679 s; QuadLayoutPatchColouring stages 0.258->0.245 s; outputs identical); scan load 335->303 ms; flip-geodesics hover warm best 174->184 ms (+5%), prepare 194->240 ms; repair_mesh 1.88->2.29 s (+22%), cold repair sum +16%, orientation check +8%, export +8%. Repair output differs from master (IMG_4109 V 468508->468526, F 937044->937080) and already did in the Nov 15 runs. CrawfishQuadLayoutBenchmark refuses every crawfish scan on both trees (folded faces), so no crawfish quad-layout timing.

Consolidation pass (five subagents): shared bulk ops moved onto PackedPoints (copyFrom, gather, addScaled, lerpToward, transformPositions, transform, normalizeEach, bounds, centroid, arcLength, ringMean, distanceSquared, nearest; positions as Vector3f) and TriangleGeometry (normal/area/cornerAngle moved off PackedPoints, area now in double; bulk normals [parallel], areas, centres, boxes); MeshTopology.bounds() replaces the duplicate HalfEdgeMesh/ArrayMesh bounds code. About 60 caller files converted; API +424 lines, callers -864, main sources about 440 lines smaller. Verify: 813 tests, 0 failures; wt done passed. Retimed cold against master f508c94f, 6 alternating rounds: repair_mesh median 1.93 -> 2.40 s (+24%), cold repair per-scan median 2290 -> 2741 ms (+20%); repair output counts now match master (double area). Cause of the cold gap, from async-profiler at 100us plus the JIT log: C1-compiled code with inlined PackedPoints.get reloads xyz/first/stride and multiplies on every read; castBackRays (+315 ms CPU) and faceRange (+56 ms) dominate and were left alone in this pass; C1-only runs show eng-44 +32%, warm runs equal.

Consolidation pass 2 (three subagents): PackedPoints gains view(array, first, stride, count), slice, concat, groupMeans, ringMean(rings, includeSelf), maxDistance, segmentDistanceSquared(a, b, Vector3f, bound); TriangleGeometry gains normals(points, corners, fallback) and a double cornerAngle. SurfaceSpline.spanDistanceSquared/axisGap and DisplacementSum.selfAndRings deleted; ~30 caller sites converted. API +159 lines, callers about -185. verify: 813 tests, 0 failures.

Face centroid has one way: MeshTopology.faceCentroid now sums corners in double without building facePoints, and faceCentroids() gives every live face's in parallel. Hand-written copies replaced in SurfaceConnection, RingRegions (face table, nearestActiveFace via PackedPoints.nearest, label and crease points), SurfaceWaypoints, AttachToSurfaceNode, InsetFacesNode. verify: 813 tests, 0 failures.
review-summary: PackedPoints is now a buffer object indexed by point, and the triangle, frame and angle maths that many classes each copied now lives once on PackedPoints and MeshTopology. Every reader stops writing index arithmetic, and the angle sites can no longer produce NaN.
